from glom.core import glom
from glom.mutation import assign

target = {
    'teams': [
        {'name': 'red', 'members': [{'name': 'Ada'}, {'name': 'Bob'}]},
        {'name': 'blue', 'members': [{'name': 'Cyd'}]},
    ]
}
team_names = glom(target, ('teams', ['name']))
members = glom(target, ('teams', ['members']))
counts = {team: len(group) for team, group in zip(team_names, members)}
assign(target, 'summary.teams', team_names, missing=dict)
assign(target, 'summary.counts', counts, missing=dict)

print(team_names)
print(counts)
print(target['summary'])
